caption: The drawing depicts a small drawstring bag with a brown top section and a light brown string tied in a loose knot. The body of the bag is decorated with colorful beadwork showing a rural scene: in the main section, there is a large tree with green leaves to the left, and several small houses in pink, yellow, and white with blue and red roofs set against a light blue background. A curved pink path runs from the foreground to the background, passing the houses. Above the scene, there is a horizontal band with a series of circular decorative motifs on a red background. Below the village scene, there is a smaller green band with two trees and a pink house. Blue drooping fringes hang from the bottom of the bag. The whole bag is rendered in muted but distinguishable colors, placed centrally on an off-white background with no other objects or details.
title: Beaded Bag
